hub_integration.step2_desc: In TM Tools Vue components or composables, data loading from Hub is standardized via the useHub() composable:
hub_integration.feature_routes_desc: TM Tools navigation sidebar is not hardcoded, but loaded from TM Hub system_routes table via GET /api/v1/apps/:appId/routes and filtered by current user permissions.

hub_integration.feature_docs_desc: The /system/docs page calls GET /api/v1/apps/:appId/docs. TM Hub fetches real-time content from MongoDB (app_contents), automatically updating Tools immediately upon changes on Hub.
hub_integration.feature_connections_desc: The /resources/connections page manages 3rd-party credentials (Runway, Luma, Cloudinary, OpenAI, etc.). Data is encrypted using AES-256-GCM on TM Hub.
